intent: Select existing source geometry and change only its construction flag. Keep coordinates, expressions, constraints, stable IDs, owner and datum association.
steps: Create sketch:new_1 owned by feature:sketch_new_1 on existing feature:datum using current identity/revision. Plan/apply the primitives below through the existing typed sketch gateway.

Inspect construction_targets (separate from constraint_targets). Select ent:disc and plan operation construction=false: profile_effect goes from zero to one closed loop. Review does not publish source.
Apply that flag-only operation, then create a 6 mm NewBody extrusion feature:disc_body of profile:circle:ent:disc.

Plan/apply ent:ellipse construction=false: one to two closed profiles, with existing circle consumer unchanged. Plan/apply ent:a construction=true: two to two closed profiles; a point flag does not remove curves using that point.
Inspect the exact original expressions, including radius '1 cm'. The unconsumed ellipse has construction=false; grade it independently of solid volume.
Attempt ent:disc construction=true: the consumer loop would disappear and must refuse atomically. Undo/Redo restores complete source and flags through opaque history.
compatibility: ADR-107; existing authored point/line/circle/ellipse/arc flags only. Construction point flags do not remove referencing curves. Existing consumers must retain exact profile membership. No new geometry, solver, sampler, schema or cubic/helper editing. MCP expresses typed intent, not mouse events.
